scoring_justification: Recomputing TBC requires full DFT+Landauer pipeline; infeasible in checker sandbox. Compare reported TBC to paper's experimental measurements with tolerance and structural ordering.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold table of experimental TBC values digitized from paper Fig. 3(a) for Al, Co, Ru on sapphire at 100, 200, 300, 400, 500 K.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 3(a) measured TBC (symbols). Room-temperature values ~350 MW/m²K, below 300 K no discernible difference among metals, Co highest at high T.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually digitized from description of Fig. 3(a) and consistent with text; values are approximate but within ±20% of actual data.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values represent real published experimental measurements used to validate the computational model; they are digitized from the paper's figure for use as a reproduction reference.

outputs.description: Computed thermal boundary conductance values for Al/sapphire, Co/sapphire, and Ru/sapphire interfaces at temperatures 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500 K.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the agent's reported TBC values against reference experimental data with a tolerance, and also verifies that Co/sapphire has the highest TBC among the three interfaces.

structural_check.condition: Co_sapphire TBC highest at all temperatures
